name: Kiritou Kureha
source:
A girl who has the ability to destroy bodachs and who is also [url=/c41749]Shinji's[/url] classmate.
She works with Sakura no Mori Dreamers to protect the people of her town.
Before meeting Shinji, she was looking for a partner to work with after her friend [url=/c41747]Mifuyu[/url] left. She decided to cooperate with him after their first meeting.
Despite this, she is like a normal girl - her biggest concern is that because of her very busy job, she has no time to socialize with boys.
Her casual attire consists of a kimono.
